readme: Recipe Hunter ingredient worklist. Written by ingredient-queue.ps1 only. An ingredient is CARRIED when ONE store carries it; NOT-CARRIED only when all seven have been CHECKED and none do. Unchecked is never not-carried.

items.why: tier1 ABSENT: no board cell, nothing in captures

Walmart.evidence: NOT SEARCHED - second attempt 2026-08-15 confirms the block is not transient. (1) claude-in-chrome tabs_context_mcp returned "Claude in Chrome is not connected" on 3 more consecutive calls, createIfEmpty true and false; no tab could be opened. (2) The in-app browser pane (mcp__Claude_Browser__*) and list_connected_browsers were NOT present in this agent session toolset at all, so the second browser surface could not be tried. (3) chrome.exe is running but exposes no CDP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9222/json/version refused), so no scripted attach was possible. (4) Server-side fallback ruled out, not skipped: probe-ingredient.ps1 documents these five as browser-only, and a WebFetch of the Hy-Vee aisles-online search URL returned the documented client-rendered shell with zero product hrefs. Omaha store identity and In-Store price mode were therefore never verifiable and no search ran. UNCHECKED, not an absence.
